text:
sre-oncall: SLO alert just fired for hosted-infer/usw2 — p99 latency and 5xx fraction both spiking since ~12:23 UTC. Alert: hosted-infer.gateway.5xx_fraction > 2% for 5m. Can we triage?

alice: seeing customer escalations from Acme about repeated timeouts (504) and a few 502s. Support put a ticket in: TKT-8412.

ben: looking at logs — gateway proxy returning upstream: "handshake_timeout" and "request_timeout" patterns. Lots of traces with no downstream spans (trace gap).

carmen: dashboard snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/hosted-infer/usw2 -> p99 latency jump correlated with batcher queue length rising. CPU on batcher nodes ~70% but GPU util low.
\

infra-bot: @sre-oncall automated note: probing prefetched connection pool exhausted metric (prefetch.pool.used_ratio) = 0.98 in region usw2. Suggest reducing prefetch concurrency or adding burst capacity.

dima: quick repro: curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"llm-alpha-1","input":"echo test","max_tokens":256}' -> consistently hangs ~8s then 504. Adding header X-Debug:1 returns fast 200s for some requests.

alice: interesting, X-Debug toggles behavior — could be tracing injection changing route (sampling) or hitting different proxy path. Any header-based routing? @eng-runtime

eng-runtime: no header routing configured intentionally. But we did deploy a transient envoy filter last night for extended tracing — might have a bug degrading pooled connections. Rolling back filter is an option.

ben: trace ids for failed requests: 1a2b3c..., 4d5e6f... searching traces shows initial ingress span then nothing. We have trace gap where backend never shows up.

carmen: suggest steps: 1) enable debug logs on gateway pods for 15m (capture handshake timeouts), 2) collect tcpdump on batcher-proxy, 3) rollback envoy tracing filter, 4) temp scale batcher pool + allow burst capacity.

support-bot: Customer Acme (prod) experiencing retries and timeouts — escalation emailed to account team. SLA window impacted. Please prioritize.

dima: I've posted a quick repro in test env and can reproduce 504 when batcher queue > 1200 items. Attaching the minimal script:

```bash
for i in $(seq 1 300); do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"llm-alpha-1","input":"x","max_tokens":16}' &
done
wait
```

ben: running that locally reproduces p99 spikes. Query I'm using to inspect logs:

```
jsonPayload.service="gateway" AND jsonPayload.upstream_status=~"5.." | group_by(jsonPayload.upstream_status) | sort desc
```

alice: action items: @eng-runtime please confirm whether you can rollback the envoy filter (hotfix) within 10m. @eng-sre team scale batcher pool + enable prefetched burst. @dima collect tcpdump + core dump of one failing gateway pod and upload to /mnt/triage/TKT-8412.

eng-runtime: rolling back the tracing filter now (rolling restart of the small subset). ETA ~6m.

infra-bot: autoscaler triggered +2 batcher instances in usw2. Prefetch pool lowered to 60% of previous config.

ben: quick dashboard after changes: 5xx fraction dropped to 0.6% and p99 latency back to baseline in the last 2m. Still seeing a tiny tail.

alice: thumbs up. keep collecting traces for the earlier window. If trace gaps persist after rollback, we escalate to runtime team for deeper proxy kernel investigation.

support-bot: updated customer: temporary mitigation applied, monitoring. Ticket TKT-8412 updated and tagged for postmortem.

carmen: assigning postmortem owner @dima. Please include: timeline, root cause hypothesis (envoy filter + pool exhaustion), repro steps, mitigations, and follow-up (add canary for envoy filters and trace coverage tests).

sre-oncall: closing loop for now — will re-open if 5xx fraction >1% for 5m. :eyes: :thumbsup:
